landing.description: Research and writing by Antonio Mora. Now: can AI agents find a trading edge? 53 ideas tested so far.

about.title: Antonio Mora | moratowers
about.description: Antonio Mora tests whether AI agents can trade prediction markets. Since December 2025 he has tested 53 trading ideas, with one agent building and a different one checking.

story.title: Story | moratowers
story.description: How the research began in December 2025, why 898 paper trades turned out to be fake, and how the audit of 53 trading ideas was frozen before its programs were written.

rules.title: Eight research rules for testing trading ideas | moratowers
rules.description: Eight rules for testing trading ideas with AI agents, most with the failure that taught them, from modelling fills against the real trade tape to asking whether a question is decidable. Each links to a free Claude Code skill.

landing.question: Can AI agents find a trading edge?
landing.result: 53 ideas so far. None has beaten luck yet.
landing.now: now: can AI agents find a trading edge?

results: One program scored them and a second, written separately, checked the numbers, under a plan frozen first.
